correctness.rationale: Five exhaustive vertex-pair automorphism orbits. The quotient/internal-difference decomposition is an exact invariant direct sum. SymPy establishes each symbolic rational identity and all four positive-factor differences over m,k; all factors are strictly positive for integer m>=3 and real k>0. The m=3 empty-part case was checked symbolically with its actual quotient. A separate full-matrix path checks 60 exact-rational orbit instances. Hence the proof does not extrapolate from finite tests.

value.rationale: Exactly solves the two-equal-gain noisy-leader design problem for every bridge-barbell of equal clique size at least three and every positive finite gain, including objective and strict all-optimal-pair classification. Proves bridge hubs are never optimal despite their key intercommunity connectivity, a meaningful robust structural design fact not obtainable from generic heuristics.
